rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and visible ICM, but overstates certainty of TE quality and zona thinning from a single image; image appears somewhat collapsed/less clearly expansive than described.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor context, prior biochemical pregnancy, and endometrium with embryo quality reasonably well, though some interpretations (e.g., FSH significance, lining being unequivocally ideal) are overstated.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with conclusions broadly following from embryo grade and patient age; minor issues include overconfidence in implantation estimate and some unsupported assumptions.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF principles and Gardner grading, but includes questionable claims such as >12 mm being generally associated with higher implantation, routine luteal defect concern from high AMH, and somewhat casual mention of freeze-all/PGT-A.

Provides practical next steps including proceeding with transfer, alcohol cessation counseling, luteal support, and future-cycle considerations; however, some recommendations are not sufficiently individualized or evidence-qualified.
